title: Animals and insects
subtitle: pets, farm animals, wild animals, insects, sea creatures
summary: Name the animals, insects and sea creatures around us, and talk about keeping pets and protecting rare animals.

lesson.heading: Pets
lesson.text: A **pet** is an animal that lives with people. In the UK many people **keep pets**. The most common are **dogs** and **cats**, but people also keep **birds**, for example **parrots**, that are usually in a **cage**.

examples.text: Cats and dogs are the most common **pets** in the UK.
Some people keep more unusual animals as pets, e.g. **frogs**, **snakes** and **spiders**.
I don't like keeping birds in a **cage**; they need more space.

lesson.heading: Farm animals
rows: we get wool from it (one sheep, two sheep)
a large pink or black farm animal
the male animal that goes with a cow
big and strong; people ride it
smaller than a horse, with long ears
a small animal with horns that eats almost anything

lesson.heading: Wild animals
lesson.text: **Wild animals** normally live in natural conditions. If you are lucky, you may see them **in the wild**, that is, living free, but you will probably see them in a **zoo**.

examples.text: I've only seen **wild** animals in zoos or on TV.
Some of these animals, for example tigers, are now quite **rare**.
examples.note: rare = not often seen or found

examples.text: It's hard to see tigers **in the wild** because they are now rare.
It is important that we **protect** these **endangered** animals.

lesson.heading: Wild animals and what they do
rows: very clever, and similar to humans
can travel through the desert for long distances without water
can eat leaves from tall trees while standing on the ground
can pick things up with its trunk
sometimes changes its skin several times a year
a tiger, a lion, a leopard, a bear
big, strong animals; the tiger is now rare

lesson.heading: Insects
lesson.text: The most common **insects** in English are the **bee**, the **ant**, the **mosquito**, the **fly** and the **butterfly**. A butterfly has beautiful **wings**.

examples.text: I hate ants and mosquitoes. In fact, I hate all **insects**.
A **bee** can sting you, but it also makes honey.

lesson.heading: Sea creatures
lesson.text: A **creature** is a living thing, for example an animal. Many different creatures live in the sea: the **whale**, the **dolphin**, the **shark** and the **octopus**.
Watch the plurals: one mouse - two mice, one sheep - two sheep, one fish - two fish.

exercises.prompt: Put each creature in the right group.
Cats and dogs are the most common ___ in the UK.
exercises.explanation: A pet is an animal that lives with people.

exercises.prompt: I've only seen ___ animals in zoos or on TV.
exercises.explanation: Wild animals normally live in natural conditions.

exercises.prompt: I don't like keeping birds in a ___; they need more space.
exercises.explanation: Birds like parrots are usually kept in a cage.

exercises.prompt: I hate ants and mosquitoes. In fact, I hate all ___.
exercises.explanation: Ants, bees, flies, mosquitoes and butterflies are all insects.

exercises.prompt: It's hard to see tigers in the wild because they are now ___.
exercises.explanation: Rare = not often seen or found.

exercises.prompt: Some animals are disappearing, so we must ___ them.
exercises.explanation: Protect = keep safe. We protect endangered animals.

exercises.prompt: Match each creature with the right fact.

pairs.right: can cross the desert without water.
can eat leaves from tall trees.
change their skin several times a year.
are clever and similar to humans.

exercises.prompt: Which animal can pick things up with its trunk?
exercises.explanation: Only the elephant has a trunk.

exercises.prompt: Which bird is kept as a pet, usually in a cage, and can even talk?
exercises.explanation: Parrots are popular pets and some of them can copy human words.

exercises.statement: A butterfly is an insect with large coloured wings.
exercises.explanation: Correct. The butterfly, the bee, the ant, the fly and the mosquito are all insects.

exercises.statement: A dolphin is a farm animal.
exercises.explanation: A dolphin is a sea creature. Farm animals are sheep, pigs, cows, horses, donkeys, chickens, goats and bulls.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in order to make a sentence about endangered animals.
exercises.answer: It is important that we protect these endangered animals.
exercises.explanation: Endangered animals are ones that may soon disappear, so we protect them.
